text:
$BTC slipped to $82,637, down 2.4% after hitting $85,159 earlier. Volume was about 15.5k BTC, with roughly $1.3 B traded.

$ETH fell 2.6% to $2,638, after a high of $2,720. 220k ETH changed hands, moving about $589 M in quote volume.

$BNB slid 2.36% to $758.94, barely below its $784.55 peak. 93k BNB traded, pushing $72 M of quote volume.

Watch the next 4-hour candle on $BTC for any break of the $82,300 support line.
